items.title: Why Analog Devices Stock Is In Focus Ahead Of Results
items.summary: Analog Devices reported fiscal fourth quarter results with revenue guidance that management indicated was well above seasonal patterns, supported by AI related demand that now represents about 20% of the business. Management pointed to stable inventory days and lean customer stocking, suggesting current AI driven orders reflect underlying consumption rather than restocking, even as Analog Devices' trading has become closely tied to Nvidia and wider AI sentiment.
